title: oxygraphis cymbalaria
intro: Oxygraphis cymbalaria, commonly known as the Tibetan angelica or Oxygraphis root, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family. This plant is traditionally used in Tibetan medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxygraphis cymbalaria include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Oxygraphis cymbalaria include coumarins, lignans, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
